_frozen: 2026-10-18, before any benchmark, validation run or production run of this study (docs/hybrid_short_T/PREREGISTRATION.md). Edits after the freeze go into a dated amendment in the preregistration, never silently here.
question: Does the best hardware-aware ABF+FR deployment reach a given free-energy accuracy faster in measured wall-clock time than the best hardware-aware ABF deployment, at the shortened equal walker-step budgets of results/equal_budget_v2/short_T?

hardware.gpu: NOT USED. User instruction 2026-10-18 (answer 'CPU only'): at launch all four H200 NVL (GPU 0-3) carried other users' jobs at 98-100 % utilisation; the project's standing device (GPU 3) held a 58 GB training job. The CPU/H200 crossover is therefore NOT MEASURED in this study.
hardware.host: 2 x AMD EPYC 9554 (128 physical cores, SMT-2, 16 CCDs of 8 cores, CCD i = cores 8i..8i+7, sibling of core c = c+128), 1.5 TB RAM, shared with other users
hardware.allocation: every timed run (benchmark, validation-timing, production, confirmation) holds an EXCLUSIVE CCD set of this campaign: t <= 8 threads -> one CCD, t = 16 -> two CCDs of one NUMA node (scripts/final_campaign/expB_alloc.py topology and lock registry); the run is pinned (taskset) to the first t cores of the set; the other cores of the set are not used by this campaign
hardware.allocation_choice: least-loaded CCD set by the busy fraction (2 s /proc/stat sample) of the cores the run will use and their SMT siblings; a set whose used cores and siblings are all <= 10 % busy qualifies; if none qualifies the launcher re-samples every 5 s up to 60 s, then takes the least-loaded set and FLAGS the allocation (other users' unpinned processes roam over every CCD of this host)
hardware.contention_rule: expB_alloc.contention, scope 'own' (the run's cores and their SMT siblings), 1 Hz telemetry monitor pinned outside every allocation: contended iff foreign busy > 0.10 on any of those cpus or > 5 involuntary context switches per thread-second over the window; missing telemetry = 'unknown' = contended
hardware.repeats: a run contended over its WHOLE timed window is repeated (fresh process, new allocation), at most 3 repeats; engines are deterministic, so a repeat must reproduce the first replicate's science arrays bitwise (checked by sha256) and only its timing is new
hardware.replicate_choice: per endpoint, the first replicate uncontended over that endpoint's window ([0, W] for time-to-accuracy, the whole run otherwise); runs with no such replicate are flagged and enter the primary analysis with their first replicate; sensitivity analysis excludes them

backends.serial: S1: the validated serial numba engine (src/gateway_ladder_numba.py / src/lta_ladder_numba.py, run_arm, diagnostics off, its own replay noise: gateway numba MT19937 default_noise_seed(seed, N), LTA PCG64 SeedSequence([seed, N, round(T)]) child 1), one thread, timed by scripts/final_campaign/expB_common.run_serial (SaveClock hooks of scripts/mechanism/parallel_benchmark.py; warm-up of the same code path excluded)
backends.parallel: P_t: the validated walker-parallel CPU engine (src/parallel/gateway_parallel.py C/OpenMP kernel variant replicated_dissem; src/parallel/lta_parallel.py numba parallel=True, threading layer omp), counter-mode Philox4x64-10 noise (gateway key SeedSequence([seed, N, 2]); LTA key SeedSequence([seed, N, round(T), 2])), t in {1, 2, 4, 8, 16} threads with t <= N, through scripts/final_campaign/expB_common.run_parallel; initial conditions and FR uniforms are the validated engine's streams in both modes
backends.precision: float64 everywhere (no precision change in this study)
backends.replay_mode: the parallel engines' replay mode (bitwise the serial engine) is used ONLY for validation (Stage I), never for timing
backends.h200: not used (see hardware.gpu); the existing torch drivers (scripts/mechanism/bench_torch_engines.py) are documented, not run

budget_rule: n_steps(N) = B / N exactly (integer for every rung), T_N = n_steps(N) h; ABF at every N, ABF+FR at every N >= 2 (never at N = 1). B counts integration (walker) steps; force evaluations follow each engine's own accounting: gateway N k at completed step k, LTA N (k + 1) (the LTA engine evaluates forces at step 0).
save_grid: the ORIGINAL equal-budget production grid of the rung (engine budget_save_grid(B_orig / N): 200 uniform + 24 log-spaced budget fractions, union the frozen physical-time checkpoints) restricted to steps <= n_steps(N), plus the physical checkpoints t <= T_N.  The last save is exactly n_steps(N) (= the k*-th original uniform point).  'budget grid' = the 24 log points + the k* uniform points (identical in u/u* at every N); the physical checkpoints are extra saves for figures only.
frozen_algorithm: configs/equal_budget_v2/{gateway,lta_300K,lta_150K}_production.json engine_cfg, unchanged (potentials, Langevin, histogram P0 ABF, FR constants, FR start at step 20000 and fr_every 5 for LTA, gateway physical-time ramp ramp_t 4 t.u. and fr_interval_t 0.004, caps max(1, floor(0.08 N)) gateway / max(1, int(0.02 N)) LTA, clips, warm-up / burn-in); diagnostics off in every run of this study (bit-inert in both engines)

benchmark.configs: every N of the ladder; ABF at every N, FR at N >= 2; backends serial and parallel t in {1, 2, 4, 8, 16}, t <= N
benchmark.order: the full configuration list in a fixed shuffled order (default_rng(20261018)), repeat r runs that list rotated by r L / 3; repeat r uses bench_seeds[r]
benchmark.window: n_b(N) = max(bench_min_steps, ceil(bench_walker_steps / N)) steps from the run start (the production configuration truncated), saves at 20 uniform steps plus fr_start (LTA)
benchmark.steady_state: c_ss = (wall at the last save - wall at save s0) / (N (n_b - s0)), s0 = the first save >= max(n_b / 2, fr_start for LTA); FR is active over the whole steady-state window in every FR configuration (gateway from step 0, rate ramping in physical time; LTA from step 20000)
benchmark.end_to_end: c_e2e = (process end-to-end wall: process start .. end of the timed run) / (N n_b); reported, used only in the sensitivity analysis
benchmark.concurrency: up to 6 benchmark runs at a time, each on its own exclusive CCD set (the same conditions as production); contended runs are repeated as in production

routing.rule: Per system and N, from the ABF benchmark only (median over the uncontended repeats of c_ss): P* = the fastest parallel thread count; any parallel config within 3 % of it counts as tied and the tie goes to fewer threads.  Route N to P* iff median c_ss(P*) <= median c_ss(S1) / 1.05 AND every repeat of P* is faster than every repeat of S1; otherwise route N to S1.  ABF and FR at that N both run on the routed backend (common-backend primary analysis).
routing.secondary: deployment-optimised: the same rule applied to each method's own benchmark; where it differs from the common route, the alternative wall time is a PROJECTION (measured W x c_ss(own route) / c_ss(common route)), labelled as such
routing.freeze: results/hybrid_short_T/routing/routing.json is written once from the benchmark summary, with the engine source hashes, BEFORE any production run; production refuses to start without it or if the engine sources changed

production.seeds: prod_seeds of each system (32 gateway, 16 LTA each), fresh (never used by any earlier study; checked by scripts/hybrid_short_T/check_seeds.py)
production.order: seed-major blocks; within a seed the arms in the order default_rng(20261018 + seed).permutation; systems interleaved by block
production.smoke: the first 2 seeds of every system run first and are inspected for pipeline faults only (record completeness, contract, scorer, contention, ledger); they are kept as production runs if their signature is unchanged
production.confirmation: after the exploration analysis: per system the best ABF configuration and the best FR configuration (argmin of the median W_mid over the exploration seeds; censored = inf) are re-run on confirm_seeds (32 fresh seeds each, the same backend); R_wall^conf = median W_mid(best FR) / median W_mid(best ABF) with a 10 000-resample unpaired bootstrap 95 % CI.  A method whose best median W_mid is censored (inf) has nothing to confirm (reported).

analysis.scorer: the frozen equal-budget e_F scorer (scripts/equal_budget/eqb_metrics.make_scorer: gateway accepted analytic scorer on (M_all, C_all), RMS over the 151 eval-window nodes after centring; LTA production accumulators once populated, else all-steps, RMS over 180 bins after mean removal), frozen references results/equal_budget_v2/references/
analysis.time_to_accuracy: tau = the first budget-grid save after which e_F <= eps at EVERY later budget-grid save (eqb_metrics.persistent_first); W = wall_s_at_save at tau (seconds since the engine's timed start: excludes process start, imports, JIT / cache load and the engine warm-up); W_e2e = W + (timed start - process start); censored (never sustained by the end of the budget) = inf, never imputed.  Retrospective diagnostic, not an online stopping rule.
analysis.endpoint: e_F at T_N (the last save); Ibar_F = mean of e_F over the k* uniform saves
analysis.best_allocation: scripts/equal_budget/eqb_metrics.best_allocation on W_mid (lower is better, inf allowed): candidates ABF at every N, FR at every N >= 2, each on its routed backend; the minimising N is re-selected in every one of 10 000 seed resamples (one index draw per N shared by both methods); R_wall = best FR median / best ABF median, CI from the resampled relative difference.  Labelled EXPLORATORY (selection and estimation on the same seeds); the confirmation stage provides the confirmatory test.
analysis.decision: confirmatory: 'FR faster' iff the confirmatory 95 % CI of R_wall lies below 1; 'ABF faster' iff it lies above 1; otherwise 'unresolved' (never 'equivalent')
analysis.fixed_N: per N: paired FR / ABF ratio of W_mid (seed-paired, bootstrap of the median paired log-ratio; censoring: inf-aware medians), wins; the same for e_F(T_N) and Ibar_F (as results/equal_budget_v2/short_T)
analysis.frontier: per method, best median e_F at wall budget w over the eligible (N, backend): e_F(w) = the error of the latest save at or before w (e_flat before the first save); a run that completed before w carries its final estimate forward, drawn distinctly (completed, not sampling)
sensitivity: throughput uncertainty: every W of a configuration scaled by its benchmark max/min c_ss ratio
hybrid projection with the validated engine's law: tau_u of the original equal-budget production runs (seeds production_reference_seeds, truncated at u*) x B x the routed benchmark c_ss
force evaluations and used core-hours to accuracy

guards.core_hours_convention: USED core-hours = threads x process wall of every run process of this study (benchmark, validation, production, confirmation), ledger results/hybrid_short_T/compute_ledger.csv; the idle cores of an exclusive CCD are reported separately as allocated core-hours
guards.disk: pause below 2 GB free, resume at 3 GB (expB_common.DiskGuard)
guards.projection_gate: after the benchmark: projected used core-hours of the remaining stages; if over the cap, production runs seed-major (every configuration gets the same seeds) until the cap, and the incomplete seeds are reported as NOT RUN
